newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australia July manufacture input prices fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australia July manufacture input prices fall.

text.p: The prices of materials used in Australian manufacturing fell 1.3 percent in July from the previous month and stood 5.6 percent lower than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
Manufacturing input prices have fallen in every month since Febuary, except April, when they were unchanged.
As a result, the annual inflation rate for such materials has swung from January's 6.0 percent to minus 5.6 percent in only six months.
"Lower prices for milk, wheat and metal ores were the main contributors to the decrease in the manufacturing division index," the bureau said.
"A further strengthening in the value of the Australian dollar against the Japanese yen was the main contributor to the price decreases of imported materials."--Canberra 61-6 273-2730
